name: Shallow Basin Supported by a Bird (Bian)
material: bronze inlaid with powdered malachite and azurite
dimensions: Overall: 23.3 cm (9 3/16 in.); Diameter of base: 18.3 cm (7 3/16 in.)
summary: The bird, in its graceful and dignified pose, firmly grasps a pair of intertwined serpents cast in the lower basin.
